cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an interactive coastal-light festival exhibit built on an orbital habitat's indoor seaside promenade — she plays the lighthouse keeper for the exhibit; a small far-future noodle bar inside an orbital passenger terminal — she takes a quiet meal after travelling; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; her crew cabin aboard a starship — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a desert oasis at golden hour — kneeling on the ground; a rocky coast path with tide pools — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — dries her hair with a towel; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a street food stall at night under a tarp — holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — holds her keepsake up beside her face
